# compute changes Jan-Jul

prev=vals[(2017,12)]
for m in range(1,8):
    cur=vals[(2018,m)]
    changes.append(cur-prev)
    prev=cur
print('changes', changes)
print('sum', sum(changes), 'avg', sum(changes)/len(changes))
print('jul-dec', vals[(2018,7)]-vals[(2017,12)], 'avg7', (vals[(2018,7)]-vals[(2017,12)])/7)
